paper_metadata.title: Deformation Twinning Behavior in High Ni-Austenitic Materials

evidence.quote: TWIP can occur in the Ni based super alloy Alloy 625 at cryogenic temperature, which increases both strength and ductility.

alloy_systems.name: high Ni super austenitic stainless steel

mechanisms.name: decrease of stacking fault energy with decreasing temperature

evidence.quote: stacking fault energy of an alloy is correlated to temperature, which will decrease with decreasing temperature [9]. This will also decrease the critical strain to initiate twinning.

mechanisms.name: competition between deformation twinning and dislocation formation

evidence.quote: According to Meyers´constitutional model [ 9], formation of deformation twins is a competitive process with formation of dislocation.
